sous_titre: Milliards de dollars, par trimestre, du premier trimestre 2025 au deuxième trimestre 2026

T1 2025.texte: Total U.S. annuity sales were $106.3 billion in the first quarter of 2025, level with the record set in 2024

T2 2025.texte: Total U.S. annuity sales increased 8% year over year to a record high $119.2 billion in the second quarter

T3 2025.texte: Total U.S. annuity sales increased 5% to $121.2 billion in the third quarter of 2025

T4 2025.texte: Fourth quarter sales jumped 14% to $117.2 billion, representing the ninth consecutive quarter of $100+ billion in sales.

T1 2026.texte: Total U.S. annuity sales were $107.4 billion in the first quarter of 2026, a 1% increase from 2025

T2 2026.texte: Total U.S. annuity sales rose 4% year over year to a record $123.9 billion in the second quarter of 2026
